name: imrotate
expr: R90 = imrotate(J, 90); Rb = imrotate(J, 30, 'bilinear'); Rc = imrotate(J, 30, 'bicubic'); Rbc = imrotate(J, 30, 'bilinear', 'crop'); Rm = imrotate(J, -45, 'bilinear');
comment: MATLAB imrotate — covers 90 deg exact (loose), 30 deg bilinear + bicubic (interior interpolated values), 30 deg bilinear 'crop' (3x4 output), and -45 deg bilinear. Pins sizes + interpolated interior values + sums. Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b (tol=1e-6 for interpolation). KNOWN GAPS (tracked in a dedicated fix task, NOT fingerprinted): (1) 'crop' bbox returns the wrong size for a 90 deg rotation of a non-square image (numkit 4x3 vs MATLAB 3x4); (2) 'nearest' rotation differs by one pixel on some angles (30 deg sum 87 vs 86). The interpolated 'loose'/'crop' bilinear/bicubic paths are bit-exact.
